functions.name: c00_simple_if
functions.source: fn c00_simple_if(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true; }; false }
functions.derivation: One top-level if adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c01_nested_if
functions.source: fn c01_nested_if(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { if b { return true; } }; false }
functions.derivation: The outer if adds 1; the nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c02_triple_nested_if
functions.source: fn c02_triple_nested_if(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { if b { if c { return true; } } }; false }
functions.derivation: Three nested ifs add 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

functions.name: c03_if_else
functions.source: fn c03_if_else(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true } else { return false }; false }
functions.derivation: The if and its else each add one; else is hybrid.

functions.name: c04_if_elif_else
functions.source: fn c04_if_elif_else(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true } else if b { return false } else { return true }; false }
functions.derivation: The if, else-if, and else each add one; else-if is hybrid.

functions.name: c05_three_way_chain
functions.source: fn c05_three_way_chain(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true } else if b { return false } else if c { return true } else { return false }; false }
functions.derivation: One if, two else-if branches, and one else add four total.

functions.name: c06_and_sequence
functions.source: fn c06_and_sequence(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a && b { return true; }; false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c07_or_sequence
functions.source: fn c07_or_sequence(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a || b { return true; }; false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator || sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c08_mixed_boolean
functions.source: fn c08_mixed_boolean(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a && b || c && d { return true; }; false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; &&, ||, && form three logical sequences, adding 3.

functions.name: c09_assigned_boolean
functions.source: fn c09_assigned_boolean(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { let value = a && b; return value; false }
functions.derivation: A binary logical sequence in an assignment adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c10_while_loop
functions.source: fn c10_while_loop(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { while a { break; }; false }
functions.derivation: One top-level while adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c11_for_loop
functions.source: fn c11_for_loop(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { for item in [a,b] { let _ = item; }; false }
functions.derivation: One top-level loop adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c12_if_with_loop
functions.source: fn c12_if_with_loop(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { for item in [b,c] { let _ = item; } }; false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; the loop nested inside it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c13_nested_loops
functions.source: fn c13_nested_loops(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { for item in [a,b] { while item { break; } }; false }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1; the inner loop adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c14_switch_or_match
functions.source: fn c14_switch_or_match(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { match a { true => return true, false => return false }; false }
functions.derivation: The switch/match/select construct adds one; its alternatives add no further points.

functions.name: c15_switch_nested_if
functions.source: fn c15_switch_nested_if(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { match a { true => if b { return true; }, false => return false }; false }
functions.derivation: The switch adds 1; the if nested in it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c16_if_let_option
functions.source: fn c16_if_let_option(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if let Some(value) = maybe(a) { return value; }; false }
functions.derivation: The top-level if-let pattern is one structural if increment; the option match arm and return add none.

functions.name: c17_try_two_catches
functions.source: fn c17_try_two_catches(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { let first = maybe(a)?; let second = maybe(b)?; return first && second; false }
functions.derivation: Two ? propagation expressions add nothing; the && sequence in the return adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c18_recursive_call
functions.source: fn c18_recursive_call(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true; } return c18_recursive_call(b, a, c, d); false }
functions.derivation: The base-case if adds 1; one direct recursive call adds 1 fundamental recursion increment.

functions.name: c19_conditional_expression
functions.source: fn c19_conditional_expression(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { return if a { true } else { false };; false }
functions.derivation: Rust if expression adds 1 and its else branch adds 1.

functions.name: c20_nested_conditionals
functions.source: fn c20_nested_conditionals(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { return if a { true } else { if b { false } else { true } };; false }
functions.derivation: The outer if-expression adds 1 and its else adds 1; the inner if in that else adds 1 + 1 nesting, and its else adds 1, totaling 5.

functions.name: c21_lambda_decision
functions.source: fn c21_lambda_decision(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { [a].iter().any(|value| if *value { true } else { false }); false }
functions.derivation: The closure raises nesting by 1; its if expression and else add 2, for 3 total.

functions.name: c22_if_lambda_decision
functions.source: fn c22_if_lambda_decision(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return [b].iter().any(|value| if *value { true } else { false }); }; false }
functions.derivation: Outer if adds 1; closure if is nested in both the outer if and closure (+3), then its else adds 1.

functions.name: c23_nested_callable
functions.source: fn c23_nested_callable(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { let inner = || { if a { true } else { false } }; return inner(); false }
functions.derivation: Closure nesting adds 1 to its if; the if and else each add 1, totaling 3.

functions.name: c24_comprehension
functions.source: fn c24_comprehension(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { let values: Vec<bool> = [a,b].into_iter().filter(|value| *value).collect(); return !values.is_empty(); false }
functions.derivation: The filter lambda contains no control-flow break; the collection pipeline is a sequence of calls.

functions.name: c25_labeled_jump
functions.source: fn c25_labeled_jump(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { 'outer: loop { break 'outer; }; false }
functions.derivation: One loop adds 1; the labeled jump adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c26_null_shortcut
functions.source: fn c26_null_shortcut(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { return Some(a).unwrap_or(false); false }
functions.derivation: The unwrap_or call expresses a fallback without a structural flow break; no cognitive increment is added.

functions.name: c27_language_idiom
functions.source: fn c27_language_idiom(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { let value = maybe(a)?; return value; false }
functions.derivation: The single ? propagation expression is not a listed flow-break increment; the call and return add none.

functions.name: c28_loop_if_boolean
functions.source: fn c28_loop_if_boolean(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { for item in [a,b] { if item && a { return true; } }; false }
functions.derivation: Loop adds 1; nested if adds 1 + 1 nesting; its && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c29_else_loop
functions.source: fn c29_else_loop(a: bool, b: bool, c: bool, d: bool) -> bool { if a { return true; } else { while b { break; } }; false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; its else adds 1. The loop in the else body is at nesting level 1, so it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 4.
